attribution: PolyAI / Casanueva et al. (2020), BANKING77, CC BY 4.0. Selected train rows; planted modifications recorded separately.

cleanlab.data: 400 references + valid audit labels, out-of-fold probabilities; invalid-format audit rows excluded

embedding.representation: Symmetric document embeddings, model document prompt, L2 normalized; no query instruction

human_requirement: Independent human completes all 200 rows, identity/date and uncertainty. Constructed-truth results are preliminary controls, not human accuracy. No adaptive threshold changes.

model_review.context: Same three Qwen local neighbors, query, observed label and allowed labels only. No source truth or injection type.

neighbor_rule.rule: Flag when at least two eligible neighbors disagree with a valid observed label. Invalid format flagged separately.

selection: SHA256 seeded ordering within class; first 50 reference, next 25 audit; normalized exact texts disjoint. No test data.
